notes.title: Welcome
notes.content:
Welcome

Welcome all and thank you for joining the Waifu Slots community. Hope you all are enjoying the game. Please comment under this post with anything you want added to the game and any criticisms you have for us. 

If you want to support us further visit our website where you can find out more info and gain access to exclusive content. [url=https://studio7interactive.net/]https://studio7interactive.net[/url]

Thanks again, much love :)
